newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Jan 24.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Hanbo Steel, the flagship of the 14th largest conglomerate in Korea, was declared bankrupt yesterday.

- South Korea came under strong pressure on Wednesday from other OECD members to bring its labour law into line with basic standards observed by other advanced industrial nations, participants in an OECD panel said.
- Elena Maslova of Russia won a gold medal in the women's 15 km biathlon during the 1997 Winter Universiade which was held in Muju.
- President Kim Yong-sam and Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto are expected to avoid discussing sensitive bilateral issues during their talks.
